title: WPSS/1293/2005 of KIRAN SHAHI Vs STATE and ORS.

paras.text:
Review App. No. 1405 / 08
Delay Cond. App. 8160 / 05
In
WPSS No. 1293 of 2005
Hon. Prafulla C. Pant, J.

Mr. Durga Singh Mehta, Advocate present for the writ
petitioner.
Mr. I.D. Paliwal, Advocate present for respondent No. 6 /
review applicant.
This is Review Application M.C.C. No. 1405 of 2008,
moved by respondent No. 6, for review and recall of order dated
24.11.2006, passed in Writ Petition No. 1293 (S/S) of 2005.
The said application is accompanied with delay
condonation application No. 8160 of 2008, for condonation of
delay in moving the recall application. The delay condonation
application is allowed. The dealy is condoned.
Heard learned counsel for the parties on review
application.
The aforesaid writ petition was disposed of vide order
dated 24.11.2006, with the following order:
"Learned counsel for the parties are present.
By means of this petition, the petitioner has sought
mandamus, directing the respondents to allow the petitioner to
continue to join as Para Teacher (Shiksha Mitra) for the
academic year 2005-06.
Learned counsel for the petitioner states that he continued
to work under stay order.
The academic year 2005-06 of Shiksha Mitra is already
over, as such, this writ petition has become infructuous. The
same is dismissed as infructuous with the observation that the
petitioner shall be paid salary for the year 2005-06, provided he
has worked for that academic year. (Interim relief application
No. 14182 of 2006, stands disposed of)."
Learned counsel for respondent No. 6 / review applicant
submitted that the petitioner has not worked during the academic
year 2005-06, as such, he is not entitled to the salary for that
year.
The perusal of the order dated 24.11.2006 itself shows that
the salary is to be paid in the year 2005-06 provided the
petitioner has worked for that academic year. There is no error
apparent in the order passed by this Court which requires
recalling said order or modification in the order.
The review application is rejected.
